records.title: Delay in Maintenance of the Breakwater
details: a to e: In addition, Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways has sanctioned an amount of Rs. 272.95 crore under Sagarmala Scheme for comprehensive development of Eastern jetty of Kalpeni and its associated infrastructure. The timeline for completion of the project is 42 months.

records.title: Fisheries lee plants
details: a to e: Power supply for these facilities is ensured through the Union Territory's diesel-based generation system, while options for integrating renewable energy, including solar power, are being actively explored.

records.title: Powerhouse infrastructure in Lakshadweep.
details:
a to f): A Detailed Project Report (DPR) for augmentation and
modernization of the distribution infrastructure of the UT of Lakshadweep is envisaged by the Department of Electricity, Lakshadweep, in consultation with PFC, the nodal agency for RDSS, for appropriate funding.

records.title: Maintenance of Western Embarkation Jetties in Lakshadweep.
details: (d) Three projects viz. (i) Development of western side port facilities at Kalpeni at a cost of Rs. 168.60 crore, (ii) Development of port facilities on western side of Kadmat island at a cost of Rs. 141.85 crore and (iii) Development of port facilities at Kiltan island at a cost of Rs. 351.87 crore have been proposed by UTLA. Cochin Port Authority (CoPA) is the implementing agency for these projects and around 36 months will be required for completion of each project after Further, preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the development of port facilities at Chetlat island and western side of Kavaratti, Agatti and Minicoy are underway.

records.title: Mini Airport at Kadmath Island
details:
(a) to (e): In Union Territory of Lakshadweep, eight (8) water aerodromes namely Kavaratti,
Minicoy, Agatti, Kalpeni, Bitra, Kadmat, Kiltan, & Bangaram have been identified under UDAN 4.0 & 4.2 for seaplane operation and Kavaratti-Kadmat-Kavaratti route have been awarded to M/s Spice Jet Limited. Commencement of flight services is subject to the readiness of the Water Aerodromes

records.title: Challenges faced by fishermen of Androth Island
details: a to b: The Administration of the U.T. Lakshadweep has informed that the marine workshop at Androth was demolished in 2022 for setting up the Indian Oil Corporation depot and that a suitable building near the Fish Market has been allotted to established Marine Workshop at Androth Island by the U.T. Administration.

records.title: DIET in Lakshadweep
details: c to d: The UT administration of Lakshadweep has informed that the recruitment rules for the said post are under consideration of the Department.

records.title: Healthcare services in Lakshadweep
details: a to e: The matter of extending the contracts of these personnel is under active consideration, and a decision will be taken in due course, keeping in view the healthcare needs of the Union Territory.

records.title: Current Status of Jal Jeevan Mission
details: Thus, as on 17.03.2025, out of 19.36 Crore rural households in the Country, more than 15.53 Crore (80.20%) households are reported to have tap water supply in their homes and works for the remaining 3.83 Crore households are at various stages of completion as per saturation plan of the respective State/UT.
